description: Tanned animal hide used to cover a book. Quality varies widely by skin source, tanning agent, and finishing, and surface appearance alone is a poor guide to its strength or lasting power. Cockerell records that sulphuric acid retained from dyeing and harsh finishing both shorten the working life of a covering hide.
name: cover leather
